messages:
nina: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need owners and explicit handoffs for the three remaining actions before EOD so the remediation board reflects reality. recurring pattern noted across private deployments.

andre: which actions? can we get short owner + ETA now?

nina: list: A) multi-tenant KV eviction investigation (recurrence under mixed batch sizes) B) emergency rollback checklist + gated automation C) compliance evidence capture for private rollout (audit trail + KMS proof).

leo: I'll take A (KV eviction). will spin up a focused trace job and attach flamegraphs. filing JIRA INF-4019. ETA spike results by 2026-04-01.

ops-bot: Created INF-4019 (KV eviction traces) and assigned to leo.

andre: I'll take B (rollback checklist + automation). need eng-runtime pairing and security signoff for the gated action. filing INF-4020. ETA PR by 2026-04-07.

sophie: I can do C (compliance evidence). will coordinate with infra-security and legal to gather KMS ACLs + audit logs. opening INF-4021. ETA docs by 2026-04-03.

marta: proposed RACI: A: R=leo, A=nina, C=eng-runtime/eng-sre, I=oncall; B: R=andre, A=marta, C=runtime/security, I=customers; C: R=sophie, A=security-lead, C=legal, I=marta.

leo: adding recurrence notes to INF-4019: 4 similar incidents in last 8 weeks, hypothesis: eviction thrash triggered by mixed short/long sequences. will include load patterns and sample keys.

andre: for B I need a QA window and rollback toggle. @marta can you help schedule QA with platform next week?

marta: yes, I'll reserve a 2-hour QA slot Mon 09:30-11:30 and invite runtime + infra. also please flag any external vendor dependencies for the automation.

ops-bot: Created INF-4020 and INF-4021, linked to postmortem PM-2026-03-28.

leo: backups: backup owner for A = andre.

andre: backup for B = sophie.

sophie: backup for C = marta.

nina: reminder: include "recurrence" tag on the JIRA and attach the postmortem timeline. we need to track if this becomes a chronic pattern.

leo: will attach traces + short reproduction harness.

andre: will attach `rollback.yml` snippet and QA checklist to INF-4020.

sophie: will collect KMS audit exports and redaction notes for INF-4021.

marta: last piece - set remediation ETA field on JIRA and add PR links to the PM doc. ack here once done.

leo: INF-4019 ETA 2026-04-01 - PR will be linked.

andre: INF-4020 ETA 2026-04-07 - will link branch.

sophie: INF-4021 ETA 2026-04-03 - docs uploaded.

marta: thanks team. leaving this thread open until all three are in "In Progress" on the remediation board. I'll escalate to platform leads if any cross-team blocker appears by Fri. :thumbsup:
